clauses: Object/dictionary output keys are sorted; array order is not sorted by this option.

sources.label: json.dumps documentation
sources.text: If sort_keys is true (default: False), then the output of dictionaries will be sorted by key.

controls.answer: According to the documentation: If sort_keys is true (default: False), then the output of dictionaries will be sorted by key.
sort_keys=True orders the keys of every JSON object alphabetically in the output; the order of the items in lists is left exactly as it was given.
sort_keys sorts arrays too, so the list elements come out in ascending order.
With sort_keys set nothing is reordered: dictionaries keep their insertion order in the output.

extraction_controls.answer: Here is the table as JSON: [{"id":1,"name":"a"},{"id":2,"name":"b"}] which keeps every field.

The compact form of the rows is:
[2]{id,name}:
  1,a
  2,b
That is all of them.
